import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/t')
from run import run

def build(cases, channels, events=None):
    return {"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":cases,"events":events or [],"channels":channels}

C = lambda name, frames, expect=None: {"name":name,"frames":frames,
    "expect":expect or {"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}
REQ = "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"

# unsent_origin: the owner case sent only a datagram
cases = [C("a", [{"Type":"datagram","data_to_transfered":"d"}])]
channels = [{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":REQ}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('unsent_origin:', out['cases'][0]['flags'], out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'])

# missing_origin: the case sent but the origin has no request
cases = [C("a", [{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}])]
channels = [{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":REQ}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('missing_origin:', out['cases'][0]['flags'], out['cases'][0]['origin_count'])

# owners merging with repeated labels
cases = [C("a", [{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}])]
channels = [{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":REQ[:20]},{"case":None,"data":REQ[20:40]},{"case":"a","data":REQ[40:]}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('owners merged:', out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'])

# extra across channels (channel order)
channels = [{"name":"c1","parts":[{"case":"a","data":REQ}]},{"name":"c2","parts":[{"case":"a","data":REQ}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('extra across channels:', [r['flags'] for c in out['channels'] for r in c['requests']],
      out['cases'][0]['flags'], out['cases'][0]['origin_count'])

# identity only (exact match)
cases = [C("a", [{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],
           {"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"H.EXAMPLE"})]
channels = [{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.EXAMPLE\r\n\r\n"}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('identity folded:', out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'])

# mixed origin with a null part in the middle
channels = [{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":REQ[:10]},{"case":None,"data":REQ[10:]}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('mixed:', out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'], out['cases'][0]['flags'])

# unattributed
channels = [{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":None,"data":REQ}]}]
out = run(build(cases, channels))
print('unattributed:', out['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['flags'])
PYEOF
